title: CredibilityParams
description: Expectations & credibility parameters. SPEC-CRED-4 (continuous credibility-weighted expectations) + SPEC-CRED-6 (mission-tied credibility) + SPEC-CRED-5 (bounds and meeting-outcome weights as content).

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target expectations re-anchor toward and the inflation leg of the mission distance.

unemployment_target.description: Dual-mandate unemployment target — the unemployment leg of the mission distance.

expectations_adaptivity.description: How fast expectations track realized inflation when credibility is low (adaptive de-anchoring).

expectations_anchor_pull.description: How fast expectations are pulled toward target when credibility is high (re-anchoring). Scaled by the forward-guidance stance (SPEC-GUIDE-1).

credibility_mission_gain.description: Credibility points gained per unit reduction in dual-mandate distance per month. Higher = more responsive.

credibility_unemployment_weight.description: Weight on the unemployment gap in the dual-mandate distance. < 1 makes disinflation progress dominate so winning the inflation fight builds credibility through a recession.

anchor_threshold.description: Credibility below this counts as a month 'below anchor' for the persistent-memory stat (months_below_anchor).

cred_min.description: SPEC-CRED-5: lower bound of the credibility score. Must be below cred_max (clampCredibility degenerates if the range is inverted).

cred_max.description: SPEC-CRED-5: upper bound of the credibility score. Must exceed cred_min.

surprise_penalty.description: SPEC-CRED-5: credibility lost when a decision diverges from prior forward guidance (SPEC-CRED-1).

on_target_gain.description: SPEC-CRED-5: credibility gained when the mandate is satisfied within tolerance at a meeting (SPEC-CRED-1).

credibility_soft_ceiling.description: SPEC-CRED-7: credibility above this threshold incurs a monthly drain (prevents endgame pin at cred_max). Must be strictly between CRED_MIN and CRED_MAX — JSON Schema cannot express the cross-property constraint < cred_max, so the upper bound is enforced only at runtime by loadDynamicsParams().

credibility_drain_rate.description: SPEC-CRED-7: monthly drain per unit of credibility above credibility_soft_ceiling. Must be strictly between 0 and 1 (enforced at load time — rate ≥ 1 breaks the 1-(1-r)^(1/n) cadence scaling, SPEC-SIM-6). To prevent endgame pin, the annual drain at cred_max (drain_rate × (cred_max − credibility_soft_ceiling) × 12) must exceed the annual on_target_gain from meetings (on_target_gain × ~8 meetings/year).
